description: Worktree Isolation - git worktree management for parallel agent execution without file conflicts, supporting creation, merging, syncing, change detection, removal, and revert operations.
steps: Create src/nexus/runtime/worktree.py with the following components:
MergeResult dataclass: success bool, conflicts list[str] (conflicting file paths), merge_commit str|None (commit hash if successful)
WorktreeInfo dataclass: worktree_path str, branch str, agent_id UUID, agent_name str, created_at datetime
WorktreeManager class: __init__(). Manages git worktrees for agent isolation using subprocess calls to git.

Methods on WorktreeManager: create_worktree(repo_path: str, agent_id: UUID, agent_name: str) -> WorktreeInfo (creates branch named agent/<agent_name>-<short_id>, creates worktree at repo_path/../worktrees/<agent_name>-<short_id>), merge_worktree(repo_path: str, worktree_path: str, branch: str) -> MergeResult (merges worktree branch into current branch of repo_path), sync_worktree_to_main(repo_path: str, worktree_path: str, main_branch: str = 'main') (pulls latest main into the worktree branch via merge), has_pending_changes(repo_path: str, worktree_path: str) -> bool (checks git status for uncommitted or unmerged work), remove_worktree(worktree_path: str, branch: str, repo_path: str) -> bool (removes worktree and deletes branch), revert_worktree_commit(repo_path: str, worktree_path: str) -> bool (reverts last commit in worktree)
All git operations use asyncio.create_subprocess_exec for non-blocking execution. Include proper error handling for git failures (e.g., worktree already exists, merge conflicts).

Create tests/test_worktree.py: Test WorktreeManager using a temporary git repo created in a tmp_path fixture. Tests: create_worktree creates branch and directory, merge_worktree with clean merge, merge_worktree with conflicts returns conflict info, has_pending_changes detects uncommitted files, remove_worktree cleans up, revert_worktree_commit undoes last commit, sync_worktree_to_main pulls new commits
acceptance_criteria: create_worktree creates a git worktree with proper branch naming
merge_worktree returns MergeResult with success=True on clean merge
merge_worktree returns MergeResult with conflicts list on conflict
remove_worktree deletes the worktree directory and branch
sync_worktree_to_main brings main branch changes into worktree
findings: All 11 worktree tests pass. Full suite passes at 1070 tests. Used real git repos via tmp_path fixture for end-to-end verification.
